newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea leader beautifies Pyongyang traffic women.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea leader beautifies Pyongyang traffic women.

text.p: North Korea's de facto leader Kim Jong-il, saddened to see traffic policewomen shivering in skirts on Pyongyang's freezing streets, has kitted them out with padded trousers, fur coats and sunglasses, state media said on Friday.

The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), monitored in Tokyo, said the 54-year old Kim, who is believed to have assumed control of the country although he has not taken on his late father Kim Il-sung's official titles, later inspected the women in their new uniforms and declared them a success.
"On January 11, he said that the streets have been further brightened with changed dress of traffic control women and that they look taller and prettier than before," KCNA said.

This week, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) said food rations across North Korea had dropped to four times lower the level considered essential to maintain a healthy population.
The IFRC, which has been working with the North Korean Red Cross for two years to help feed tens of thousands of people hit by floods in 1995 and 1996, appealed for more funds for North Korea.
